scope: Compile-time provider rejection (CCCREPO001/002), real MSBuild consumer controls, and EF formal generated CRUD relational evidence on SQLite and PostgreSQL; S5 not started.

generated_crud_jit.outcome: includes SQLite/PG Q01, explicit filter/sort sensitivity and a missing-UoW negative control

generated_crud_native_gate.outcome: publish/link/run with per-scenario and total sentinels after the Widget enum fixture change

g_diagnostics.CCCREPO001: non-EF generated repository request rejected in EntitySourceGenerator and RepositorySourceGenerator; no direct SDK repository emitted

g_diagnostics.positive_control: real MSBuild EF consumer builds and emits the EF repository surface

q01.sqlite: generated WidgetAppService + real typed query adapter on EF Core SQLite: decimal/DateTime/nullable/enum filters, sort, paging, and Create under EF UoW
q01.postgresql: same query matrix through Testcontainers PostgreSQL 16; SELECT/LIMIT observed on the real database

q01.uow: the generated Create observes CurrentTransaction; a post-flush failure rolls back with zero residue; without AddUnitOfWork the same failure leaves a committed row

no runtime reflection fallback or generic IQueryable adapter added
